taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts S. mexicana; older sources may place it under Solidago sempervirens subsp./var. mexicana.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current treatments place S. mexicana in Atlantic/Gulf coastal marshes and dunes from the southeastern U.S. through coastal Texas into Mexico, not the inland Central Texas target zone.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Cultivated Central Texas records are not native county evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Southern seaside goldenrod is a coastal marsh/dune goldenrod with thick narrow leaves and an elongated, often secund terminal inflorescence; use as a nonlocal coastal comparison only.
